On October 1, 2025, Tata Motors demerged into two entities: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd and TML Commercial Vehicles Ltd (TMLCV). In this episode of the Autocar Deep Drive Podcast powered by Kotak Prime, Hormazd Sorabjee - Editor, Autocar India - and Ketan Thakkar - Editor, Autocar Professional - discuss the passenger vehicle business, what's gone right and what hasn't since the demerger.
Views expressed in this podcast belong solely to the speakers.
